name: Maid for You
source:
Melina has one dream: to see her younger brothers graduate from high school. She's been searching for a job that gives her a secure income to support her family. But year after year, it always comes down to changing jobs.

One day, her uncle has an accident and Melina is asked to be his replacement. Melina enters the Haxhold Estate.

One has a scarred heart; the other has a mental condition; and another has a dark past. All three of them hold a secret and Melina is grasping on one as well.

[From [url=https://lockvia.itch.io/maidforyou]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅琳娜有一个梦想：看到她的弟弟们高中毕业。她一直在寻找一份能给她带来稳定收入来养家糊口的工作。但年复一年，总是要换工作。

有一天，她的叔叔发生了事故，梅琳娜被要求代替他。梅琳娜进入哈克斯霍尔德庄园。

一个人有一颗伤痕累累的心；对方有精神问题；另一个有着黑暗的过去。他们三个都拥有一个秘密，而梅琳娜也抓住了其中一个秘密。

[来自[url=https://lockvia.itch.io/maidforyou]Itch.io[/url]]
